Hello,
We would like to present our instructor: Evgeny Vinnik.
Currently he is working as a frontend engineer at WhatsApp, where he is developing web interfaces using predominantly React that allow 3-rd party developers to onboard with WhatsApp API.
List of his credentials include Master of Science in Computer Science degree from the Simon Fraser University in Canada and previous work at Amazon and Microsoft as a fullstack engineer.
Evgeny has was an interviewer and an interviewee on multiple occasions for frontend and fullstack roles so do not hesitate to ask him about any questions that you have in regards to interviews, questions being asked and such. 
For the last 3 years Evgeny was working as a fully remote engineer so if you have any questions about how to be productive while being fully remote please do ask these questions as well.
And finally, Evgeny, is a fairly prolific coder and very passionate about JavaScript, React framework and its intricacies and always welcomes any discussions about those.
